order_appended.meaning: a new order was appended to the doubly linked list for the price level
order_appended.checkpoint: before removal of a non-head order

non_head_order_present.meaning: a non-head order exists in the price-level list
non_head_order_present.checkpoint: before removal of a non-head order

order_reachable.meaning: the earlier order is addressable via the limit's headOrder/tailOrder chain (visible to traversal, matching and user cancels)
order_reachable.checkpoint: after append/removal operations on the price level

order_counted_in_open_interest.meaning: the order is still counted in numBids/numAsks and open-interest counters
order_counted_in_open_interest.checkpoint: after append/removal operations on the price level

assumptions: The corruption persists because every operation is wrapped in a successful transaction.
The removal routine is invoked when cancelling or matching a non-head order.
Appending updates the forward link tail.next = newOrder and the back link newOrder.prev = tail.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of open-interest counters or numBids/numAsks, so the counted-in-open-interest observable is a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric equality.

limitations: Reachability and open-interest counting are represented as grounded Booleans because the report omits numeric counter definitions.
The plan formalizes only the orders_orphaned impact; best-price sentinel and open-interest misstatement are separate impacts not covered here.
The exact removal routine behavior is described but not shown in code fragments; runtime binding is deferred.
